info.title: Nexus API Gateway by Drasken Cloud — Management API
info.description: Control-plane API: apps, versions, revisions, endpoints, and tokens.

servers.description: Custom — set your own gateway host

host.description: Your gateway management API host (typically reachable on port 9090, internal-only)

200.description: List of tokens for the app

201.description: Token issued — raw_value shown only once

post.summary: Promote a revision to current (activate it for live traffic).

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If true, return diff without applying

post.description: Create an endpoint rule on the **current** (active) revision of the version. Returns 404 when the version has no active revision.

404.description: Version not found or no active revision

409.description: Method+path combination already exists on this revision

get.description: List all endpoint rules on the **current** revision of the version.

404.description: Version not found or no active revision

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value pairs attached to this token. Each entry is forwarded as a request header to the backend when auth succeeds — key is the header name, value is the header value.

scopes.description: Stored as JSONB in Postgres and TEXT (JSON) in SQLite.

circuit_state.description: Current circuit breaker state for this revision (computed, not stored in DB). One of: "closed", "open", "half_open". Absent when not yet probed.

weight_pct.description: Percentage of traffic this revision receives among all active (is_current=true) revisions for its version. Computed on list; absent on single-revision responses.

backend_mtls_profile.description: Name of an mTLS profile to use when connecting to this revision's backend. Profiles are configured via GATEWAY_MTLS_PROFILE_<NAME>_{CERT,KEY,CA}_PATH.

forward_claims_as_headers.description: Map of JWT claim name → forwarded request header name. Matching claim values are added as headers on the proxied request.

jwks_url.description: JWKS endpoint URL; signing keys are fetched and cached automatically.

jwt_public_key_env.description: Env-var name containing the RS256 PEM public key.

jwt_secret_env.description: Env-var name containing the HS256 JWT secret.

required_claims.description: JWT claim names that must be present; absent claims return 401.

data.description: Response payload; null on delete or error

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored in the body

gateway_path.description: Public base path on the gateway (e.g. /payments). Immutable after creation.

path.description: Path relative to the version gateway_path (e.g. /orders).

traffic_weight.description: Traffic weight for canary / weighted routing. Defaults to 100.

gateway_path.description: Full public mount path (e.g. /payments/v1). Must be globally unique. Optional — when omitted, derived as <app.gateway_path>/<version>.

backend_host.description: Upstream host (e.g. api.acme.com). When provided, rev-1 is auto-created and activated.

backend_base_path.description: Path prefix to prepend on every upstream request (default: "/").

strip_gateway_path.description: Strip the gateway_path prefix before forwarding (default: true).

health_check_path.description: Liveness probe path on the upstream (optional).

IssuedToken.description: Returned once at issuance; raw_value is never stored.

Policy.description: Middleware/validation configuration that can appear at app, version, revision, or endpoint level.

path_denylist.description: Path prefixes blocked in pass-through routing mode; matched requests return 403.

algorithm.description: Algorithm name. One of "fixed_window" (default), "sliding_window", or "token_bucket". Unknown values fall back to the service default.

traffic_weight.description: Traffic weight for canary / weighted routing.

initial_revision.description: Auto-created rev-1 revision. Present only when backend_host was supplied on create.
